# Context Overhead Benchmark

What the arsenal adds to the context of every Claude Code session before any work starts, measured from the files in this repository. It is a cost, not a saving. Estimate: tokens = characters / 4, rounded: an estimate, not a tokenizer count.

## Always-on components

| Component | Characters | Tokens (est.) |
| :--- | ---: | ---: |
| Skill listing (58 names and descriptions) (.agents/skills/*/SKILL.md frontmatter) | 23,325 | 5,831 |
| Subagent listing (18 names and descriptions) (.agents/subagents/subagent-definitions.json) | 3,569 | 892 |
| SessionStart hook: `session_core.py` (hooks/hooks.json, run in an empty project) | 991 | 248 |
| SessionStart hook: `lessons.py active --hook` (hooks/hooks.json, run in an empty project) | 426 | 106 |
| SessionStart hook: `snapshot.py show` (hooks/hooks.json, run in an empty project) | 0 | 0 |
| SessionStart hook: `guard.py baseline` (hooks/hooks.json, run in an empty project) | 0 | 0 |
| Rules without a path scope (5) (dist/claude/rules/) | 17,797 | 4,449 |
| `AGENTS.md` block (installer, project scope) | 10,943 | 2,736 |
| `CLAUDE.md` block (installer, project scope) | 11 | 3 |

Worst case for the hooks (the only always-on part that grows with project state):

| Component | Characters | Tokens (est.) |
| :--- | ---: | ---: |
| SessionStart hook: `lessons.py active --hook` (same hook, ledger of 15 lessons at the field cap) | 3,251 | 813 |

## Total per install route

| Route | Characters | Tokens (est.) | Characters, full ledger | Tokens (est.), full ledger |
| :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Plugin only | 28,311 | 7,078 | 31,136 | 7,784 |
| Plugin + `install --global --target claude` | 46,108 | 11,527 | 48,933 | 12,233 |
| Plugin + `install --target claude` in a project | 57,062 | 14,266 | 59,887 | 14,972 |

Rules that load in every Claude Code session after the installer runs: `defensive-epistemology`, `minimal-change`, `senior-engineer-core`, `testing-standards`, `token-conservation`. A generated Claude rule file loads unconditionally unless it carries `paths:` frontmatter, so a rule without globs is always loaded on this target, whatever its trigger. Path-scoped: `csharp-dotnet-standards`, `database-standards`, `frontend-standards`, `fullstack-standards`, `git-standards`, `nodejs-standards`, `python-standards`, `ui-ux-standards`.

## Live comparison (with and without the plugin)

`python3 scripts/token_benchmark.py --live` runs a fixed task set (`overhead` (one turn, no tools: the fixed cost of a session); `bugfix` (read one file and fix a one-line bug)) through `claude -p --output-format json`, once with `--plugin-dir` and once without, in an empty temporary project with user settings and MCP servers excluded, and records the `usage` and `total_cost_usd` fields the CLI reports. It spends real money on your account and is never run in CI.

Last recorded 2026-11-13 with Claude Code 2.1.321, model `haiku`, arsenal 1.3.1. Means over the runs of each arm. Token columns are summed over the turns of a run, so they are billed tokens, not context size.

| Task and arm | Runs | Input | Cache write | Cache read | Output | Cost (USD) |
| :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| `overhead`, with plugin | 1 | 2 | 17,897 | 23,832 | 4 | 0.0039 |
| `overhead`, without plugin | 1 | 2 | 7,780 | 24,365 | 4 | 0.0019 |
| `bugfix` | not yet run |  |  |  |  |  |

On `overhead` the plugin added 9,584 input-side tokens (input + cache write + cache read, with minus without). The offline estimate for the plugin-only route is 7,078.

A sample this small shows that the mode works and what one session costs. It is not evidence about savings or quality on real work.

## Limits of this measurement

- The listing format (`- arsenal:<name>: <description>`) approximates how the host announces skills and subagents. It can be off in either direction: the host may shorten descriptions to fit its own listing budget, and it adds framing of its own. Where a live `overhead` run is recorded above, compare it with the estimate.
- Hook output that embeds the install path is measured with the path written as `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}`; a real install adds the length of its own path.
- A hook's output is cut at 10,000 characters, the documented cap on `additionalContext`; the lessons hook caps its own output below that, so the full-ledger case is not truncated by the host.
- Event-driven hook output is not counted: the snapshot shown again after a compaction, and the stop gate's message when it blocks.
- The installer wraps each block in two marker lines, which are not counted.
- Nothing here measures what the skills save or cost while they run. See [EVALS.md](EVALS.md).
